title: reject_awaitable_result suppresses BaseException from cancel()/close()
description: python/src/lichen/_sync_callbacks.py:29-33: the contextlib.suppress(BaseException) around attacker-controlled cancel()/close() swallows KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit raised by a malicious hook — fail-closed is preserved (TypeError still raised, awaitable terminated best-effort), but suppressing BaseException is broader than needed. Consider suppressing Exception only, or suppressing BaseException but re-raising KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit. Needs a robustness pass; note cancel() of a cancelled Task can legitimately raise CancelledError (a BaseException), which is why the broad suppress exists — decide which contract is intended.
